power_shutdown_pending.message: A shutdown was claimed for the current PC transition.
power_shutdown_pending.action: Observe power status; explicitly wake after the PC is off. Reuse an existing accepted job ID without resubmitting work.

power_state_unconfirmed.message: The bridge power state could not be confirmed.
power_state_unconfirmed.action: Inspect bridge storage and power status. Automatic shutdown remains disabled.

power_cycle_changed.action: Read power status and use its current cycle ID.

power_issue_unresolved.message: Current work still has an unresolved issue.
power_issue_unresolved.action: Investigate or explicitly discard the affected work before releasing the power hold.

invalid_power_request.action: Provide the current cycleId for an explicit hold release.

pc_cleanup_status_unavailable.message: The PC's native cleanup status is unavailable.
pc_cleanup_status_unavailable.action: Read connection status after the PC returns; cleanup retries automatically and never replays a job.

chat_cleanup_unavailable.message: The PC could not complete an owned-chat cleanup pass.
chat_cleanup_unavailable.action: The bridge retains minimal ownership records and retries. Inspect PC storage/native availability; never delete unrelated chats or resubmit old jobs.

invalid_delivery_receipt.message: Provide the exact published file descriptor batch after importing it into app storage.
invalid_delivery_receipt.action: Verify saved destination bytes and send {files:[...]} to the job delivery endpoint.

delivery_unverified.message: This job does not have a verified successful output batch matching the receipt.
delivery_unverified.action: Read the original job; import and verify every published output before acknowledging delivery. Never acknowledge failed or uncertain work.

chat_ownership_unconfirmed.message: Native chat ownership could not be established from the immutable creation receipt.
chat_ownership_unconfirmed.action: Preserve the original request; the bridge will never delete a chat based on its name or a supplied ID.

chat_cleanup_unconfirmed.action: The bridge retries deletion of the original owned chat when the PC returns. This does not replay the job.

chat_cleanup_delegation_unconfirmed.message: The PC has not confirmed durable cleanup acceptance for this delivered job.
chat_cleanup_delegation_unconfirmed.action: The original Pi job and files remain retained. The bridge retries exact cleanup when PC storage/connectivity returns; it never replays the job.

creation_deleted.message: This request's owned chat was already deleted.
creation_deleted.action: Do not recreate expired or delivered work.

download_capacity_unavailable.message: The Pi's concurrent download capacity is in use; no file bytes were sent.
download_capacity_unavailable.action: Retry downloading the same output descriptor after an in-flight download finishes. Do not resubmit the job or request wake.

artifact_belongs_to_another_job.message: A declared output ID belongs to another job; this job's batch is not published.
artifact_belongs_to_another_job.action: Use fresh output IDs for each job. The original owning job and its verified files are preserved.

output_id_conflict.message: A declared file reuses this job's reserved inline-result ID.
output_id_conflict.action: Allocate a fresh transfer ID for the file; do not reuse reserved result IDs.

developer_terminal_report_missing.message: Native execution ended without a completed or failed developer report; the task outcome is unconfirmed.
developer_terminal_report_missing.action: Read the original inputs and diagnostic log. Repair the developer's final-report workflow; do not infer success or replay unverified side effects.

creation_observation_unavailable.message: The PC could not confirm this creation request.
creation_observation_unavailable.action: The bridge rechecks the original request's receipt after connectivity returns; do not create a replacement.

creation_receipt_unconfirmed.message: A confirmed native creation receipt is not available for this exact request.
creation_receipt_unconfirmed.action: Keep the original creation ID. The bridge only reads receipts and will not repeat an uncertain native creation.

creation_native_unconfirmed.message: The receipt's exact native chat and project could not be verified.
creation_native_unconfirmed.action: The bridge rechecks the same native ID; it will not guess another chat or create a replacement.

creation_store_unavailable.message: The PC's managed creation receipt storage could not be read or committed safely.
creation_store_unavailable.action: The original reservation remains unknown; restore PC storage access before receipt observation can succeed.

creation_request_invalid.message: The PC rejected the immutable creation envelope.
creation_request_invalid.action: Use the documented creation request fields and preserve its original ID; no replacement is automatically created.

creation_request_conflict.message: This creation ID belongs to different immutable parameters on the PC.
creation_request_conflict.action: Preserve the original app, request ID, timestamp, name and captured model. Do not retry changed parameters.

creation_not_sent.message: The PC confirmed that native chat creation was not submitted and released the exact reservation.
creation_not_sent.action: Keep the original job and unchanged inputs. The bridge observes the original reservation and retries creation only after authenticated absence; do not submit a replacement job.

creation_rejected.message: Native chat creation was explicitly rejected and the PC released the exact reservation.
creation_rejected.action: Inspect the independent job log and repair the native rejection. The bridge observes the original reservation and retries the same creation only after authenticated absence; keep its captured settings and original job ID.

creation_capacity_reached.message: The paired PC has reached its bounded capacity for unresolved native job owners.
creation_capacity_reached.action: Observe pending cleanup and allow fixed expiry to retire old owners. Keep the original queued job and its immutable request ID; never submit a replacement.

job_cleanup_authorization_unconfirmed.message: The PC has not confirmed durable cleanup authorization for this exact job owner.
job_cleanup_authorization_unconfirmed.action: Retry deleting the original job after PC storage/connectivity returns. Its Pi record and required files are retained; do not submit another job or infer that native work stopped.

dispatch_observation_unavailable.message: The submission acknowledgment was lost and native history is currently unavailable.
dispatch_observation_unavailable.action: The bridge will recheck native history after connectivity returns; keep the original request ID.

dispatch_history_unconfirmed.message: Native history could not establish a unique submission within the bounded search.
dispatch_history_unconfirmed.action: The bridge preserves the unknown outcome and rechecks without submitting another turn.

dispatch_match_ambiguous.message: More than one native turn contains this job's exact submitted inputs.
dispatch_match_ambiguous.action: The bridge preserves the unknown outcome and will not choose a turn or repeat execution.

pc_unreachable.message: The PC is currently unreachable; this job remains queued.
pc_unreachable.action: Observe connection status. A new explicit user Wake, Send to Bridge, Retry or settings Wake action may authorize one wake request when needed. Preserve the original job ID; passive recovery and automatic retries never authorize wake.

developer_busy.message: The chosen developer is processing earlier work; this job remains queued.
developer_busy.action: The bridge will retry after the developer becomes idle.

developer_selection_unconfirmed.message: Codex returned a different or malformed developer selection.
developer_selection_unconfirmed.action: Inspect this job's original native creation and selection diagnostic.

developer_state_unavailable.message: The chosen developer is not available for direct input.
developer_state_unavailable.action: Inspect this job's original native chat diagnostic; never replay unknown work.

developer_selection_rejected.message: Codex rejected selection of this developer.
developer_selection_rejected.action: Inspect this job's original native chat diagnostic.

native_submission_rejected.message: Codex rejected this job before confirming a turn.
native_submission_rejected.action: Check the chosen CLI chat and current model settings.

invalid_developer_protocol.message: The developer returned a message that does not satisfy the bridge report protocol.
invalid_developer_protocol.action: The app must treat the task outcome as unconfirmed; no output batch is published.

input_delivery_unconfirmed.message: The PC has not confirmed all input file bytes; the prompt remains unsent.
input_delivery_unconfirmed.action: The bridge will retry the same file receipts when the PC is reachable.

manual_wake_required.message: Wake requires an explicit user action.
manual_wake_required.action: Send one empty-body POST /v2/connection/wake only for an explicit user Wake, Send to Bridge, Retry or settings Wake action. Durably claim at most one attempt for that action; agents, job execution, passive polling, reconnect, startup and background recovery never authorize wake.

wake_unavailable.message: The Pi's wake sender is not configured.
wake_unavailable.action: Configure the Pi's PC and LAN pairing.

invalid_wake_request.message: The wake endpoint requires an empty request body.
invalid_wake_request.action: Send one empty-body POST only for an explicit user Wake, Send to Bridge, Retry or settings Wake action; do not attach jobs, prompts or settings.

wake_unconfirmed.message: The Pi could not confirm sending the wake packet.
wake_unconfirmed.action: Observe current connection status; an unconfirmed acknowledgment does not prove that no packet was sent.

browser_origin_forbidden.message: This private API accepts native app requests.

unpaired_app_identity.message: This app installation has not been paired with this PC.
unpaired_app_identity.action: Complete app enrollment and PC pairing.

bridge_stopping.message: The bridge is restarting or stopping.
bridge_stopping.action: Reconnect and read the saved request status.

invalid_route.message: The endpoint or its parameters are invalid.
invalid_route.action: Use an endpoint documented in the API contract.

invalid_cursor.action: Use the cursor returned by the previous catalog page.

unsupported_route.message: This method and endpoint are not supported.
unsupported_route.action: Use a method listed in the API contract.

invalid_app.message: Provide an app name of 1–255 bytes without control characters.

app_capacity_reached.message: The app's retained metadata has no safe capacity for this update, including space reserved for unfinished work.
app_capacity_reached.action: Import needed outputs, delete finished jobs or saved prompts, then retry the original request ID and unchanged input. Do not create replacement native work.

app_store_unavailable.message: The Pi could not safely read or save the app's data.
app_store_unavailable.action: Restore Pi storage access and retry the same request ID; do not create a replacement job.

app_identity_already_registered.message: This bridge installation is already registered to another app name.
app_identity_already_registered.action: Use its existing registration or a separate app installation identity.

app_registration_required.message: This app has not registered with the bridge.

app_registration_changed.message: The app registration changed while the request body was being received.
app_registration_changed.action: Read the current registration. Preserve original request IDs and reconcile accepted work; never apply the suspended request to a replacement registration.

app_request_cancelled.message: The caller cancelled the request before its body could be admitted.
app_request_cancelled.action: Preserve original request IDs and observe their authoritative records before any later user-approved attempt. Cancellation never authorizes replay or wake.

invalid_job.message: The job fields, timestamp or file descriptors are invalid.
invalid_job.action: Correct the request using the documented schema.

request_id_conflict.message: This request ID already belongs to different input data.
request_id_conflict.action: Retry with unchanged input, or use a new ID for new work.

request_deleted.message: This request was deleted or explicitly retired. Its historical execution outcome is unknown from this receipt.
request_deleted.action: Persist this receipt before retiring local tracking. Never resubmit this request or infer that native execution stopped. Preserve app-owned imports and files; use a fresh request ID only for newly approved work. The server's admission barrier has bounded retention.

invalid_retirement_request.message: The retirement endpoint requires an empty request body.
invalid_retirement_request.action: Send an empty-body POST to /v2/jobs/<id>/retire for the original unresolved ID. A retained job is returned unchanged.

job_limit_reached.message: This app has reached its capacity for live jobs and pending cleanup owners.
job_limit_reached.action: Allow fixed expiry and pending cleanup to finish, or explicitly delete finished work. Never replace an uncertain request with another ID.

input_bytes_unverified.message: An input file is missing, expired or differs from its descriptor.
input_bytes_unverified.action: Upload the exact input bytes and use the returned receipt.

model_or_effort_unavailable.message: The selected model or reasoning effort is absent from the current Codex catalog.
model_or_effort_unavailable.action: Choose a model and effort returned by /v2/codex/models.

service_tier_model_required.message: A service tier requires an explicitly selected or saved model.
service_tier_model_required.action: Choose a model before selecting a service tier. The bridge does not guess a default model.

invalid_service_tier_choice.message: Native-default service tier cannot be combined with an explicit service tier.
invalid_service_tier_choice.action: Before admission, choose either nativeDefaultServiceTier:true with an empty serviceTier or one explicit serviceTier. For an accepted job, preserve its original ID and unchanged choices; do not replace its input.

service_tier_unavailable.message: The selected service tier is absent from this model's confirmed native catalog.
service_tier_unavailable.action: Choose a service tier advertised for the selected model by /v2/codex/models.

invalid_model_settings.action: Send the documented model, effort and optional serviceTier strings.

model_catalog_unavailable.message: Codex could not return its model catalog.

codex_unavailable.message: The native Codex backend is unavailable.
codex_unavailable.action: Reconnect and retry reading backend status.

native_auth_required.message: Codex authentication is missing or rejected. New native execution is paused and the original job remains queued.
native_auth_required.action: Sign in with the intended account using the packaged PC Codex runtime. The bridge verifies authentication before starting work; never replace or replay an accepted job.

native_auth_change_pending.message: Codex login changed while its owned runtime still has active or uncertain work. New execution is paused.
native_auth_change_pending.action: Observe existing jobs. The bridge reloads only its idle owned runtime, then verifies the new login; it never stops unrelated chats or replays existing turns.

native_auth_unavailable.message: The current Bridge runtime's authentication could not be verified. New execution is paused.
native_auth_unavailable.action: Read connection codexAuth and the independent job log. Restore account/provider connectivity; the bridge rechecks authentication without resubmitting uncertain work.

native_auth_source_unverified.message: The configured native credential source cannot support verified automatic account switching.
native_auth_source_unverified.action: Use the documented managed ChatGPT file credential source for this installation. Preserve credentials and accepted jobs; do not copy or reset authentication files.

chat_creation_unconfirmed.message: This job's native chat creation is not yet confirmed; its reservation is retained.
chat_creation_unconfirmed.action: Read GET /v2/jobs/<id> for this original job. The bridge observes its original creation receipt; do not create a replacement job or disconnect to erase the unknown outcome.

invalid_prompt.message: The saved prompt is empty, too large or has invalid fields.
invalid_prompt.action: Correct the prompt; text and instructions together must fit 64 KiB.

prompt_limit_reached.action: Update or remove an existing prompt.

job_unavailable.message: This job is absent, expired or belongs to another app; its historical execution outcome is unknown.
job_unavailable.action: Never infer retirement or resubmit accepted or uncertain work from this response. For an original unresolved ID, POST an empty body to /v2/jobs/<id>/retire; preserve any retained job returned, or persist its authoritative request_deleted receipt before retiring local tracking.

job_observation_unavailable.message: The exact native job outcome could not be established.
job_observation_unavailable.action: Retry status observation without resubmitting work.

native_terminal_unconfirmed.message: The native completion is not committed by the PC adapter.
native_terminal_unconfirmed.action: Read the independent job log and restore authoritative history for the original turn. Retry observation only; do not resubmit acknowledged work.

native_interaction_required.message: Native execution requested client interaction unavailable to unattended bridge jobs.
native_interaction_required.action: Read the job log and original native outcome. The bridge requests interruption of this exact turn; repair the workflow or execution capability before new work. No approval or answer is sent.

output_unavailable.message: This output is absent, expired or belongs to another job.
output_unavailable.action: Use a file ID returned by this job's outputs endpoint.

output_bytes_unverified.message: The job's complete output batch could not be verified.
output_bytes_unverified.action: Retry output observation; do not process a partial batch.

job_output_ownership_unconfirmed.message: The developer declared outputs without matching durable PC receipts for this exact app, job and chat.
job_output_ownership_unconfirmed.action: Inspect the job log and repair the producer to queue every output with the exact authenticated handoff ownership flags before reporting. Preserve the original job; do not replay native work or acknowledge delivery.

retention_cleanup_unavailable.message: Expired or explicitly discarded bridge data could not be cleaned up safely.
retention_cleanup_unavailable.action: Restore Pi storage access and read expiredJobCleanup. Cleanup obligations retry without replaying jobs; app-owned imported files are excluded.

expired_job_cleanup_unconfirmed.message: An expired job's remaining PC cleanup has not been acknowledged.
expired_job_cleanup_unconfirmed.action: Restore PC connectivity and storage. Bridge retries its compact cleanup obligation without restoring expired payloads or replaying the job.

expired_job_local_cleanup_pending.message: Expired job records are removed, but some managed file bytes could not yet be deleted safely.
expired_job_local_cleanup_pending.action: Read expiredJobCleanup and storage diagnostics, restore access to the affected managed storage and allow cleanup to retry. Other jobs continue; app-owned imported files are untouched.

dispatch_outcome_unconfirmed.message: The bridge cannot yet establish whether Codex received this request.
dispatch_outcome_unconfirmed.action: The bridge rechecks exact native inputs automatically; keep the original request ID and do not create another submission.

job_not_interruptible.message: The saved job has no supported cancellable lifecycle state.
job_not_interruptible.action: Read the original job and its diagnostics without resubmitting it.

cancellation_pending.message: Cancellation is saved; retirement of the native turn and its background processes is not yet confirmed.
cancellation_pending.action: Read the original job status. The bridge recovers the original turn, requests interruption and verifies owned background terminal cleanup without replaying the job.

cancellation_retirement_unconfirmed.message: The PC has not confirmed retirement of this cancelled job's owned background processes.
cancellation_retirement_unconfirmed.action: Read the original job and its diagnostic log. The bridge retries exact owned-thread retirement; it does not replay the job or delete its chat early.

interrupt_unconfirmed.message: Codex could not confirm the interrupt request.
interrupt_unconfirmed.action: Read the original job status. The bridge retains cancellation intent and retries the exact turn automatically.

job_not_removable.message: This job has active or uncertain native work.
job_not_removable.action: Observe its outcome before deleting the record.

app_jobs_changed.message: The app's retained job owners changed while cleanup was being authorized.
app_jobs_changed.action: Read current jobs and retry disconnect only if discarding their terminal work is still intended. Newly accepted or replaced jobs are preserved; never replay them.
